Name: No Back Key - Right-Click Menu Fix for Android (Cinderbox)
Author: MaitoIsekai
Description:
[size=5][b]🖱️ No Back Key (Cinderbox / Android)[/b][/size]

Fixes the issue where releasing [b]Right-Click[/b] with a physical mouse sends an Android [b]Back / Escape[/b] signal that accidentally closes in-game menus (Inventory, Chests, Shops, Letters) in Cinderbox.

[b]Right-click itself is NOT blocked and continues to work normally.[/b]

[line]

[size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stops Menu Leaks:[/b] Prevents the trailing Escape signal from closing menus.[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Hotkey:[/b] Press [b]F9[/b] to enable or disable the mod anytime in-game.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Config:[/b] Fully configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] or config.json.[/*]
[*][b]Lightweight:[/b] Works out-of-the-box with zero lag.[/*]
[/list][quote]⚠️ [b]Note:[/b] While the mod is enabled, Escape will not open the pause menu. Close menus using the on-screen [b]X[/b] button, or press [b]F9[/b] to toggle the mod off.[/quote][line]

[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure [url=https://github.com/Ekyso/Cinderbox]SMAPI for Cinderbox[/url] is installed.[/*]
[*]Download the mod from the [b]Files[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]NoBackKey[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. 🚜[/*]
[/list][line]
